faces.name: Flotsam
faces.text: Mill three cards. Investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

faces.name: Jetsam
faces.text: Each opponent mills three cards, then you may cast a spell from each opponent's graveyard without paying its mana cost. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.
